claims.statement: The backend follows strict DDD layering under backend/internal/ (domain with zero framework imports, app for use-case orchestration, transport/http for the HTTP edge, infra for GORM/Redis/asynq/disbursement adapters); the wallet transactional state machine lives at backend/internal/domain/transactions/state_machine.go.

The frontend SPA under frontend/src/ separates pages by role (admin, partner, adv-partner, accountant, employee) and by viewport (mobile/ for each role), with the file responsibility rule that .tsx is UI-only and .ts holds logic/API calls.

All business time goes through clock.Now() with the Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh timezone via the centralized backend/internal/pkg/clock package; production runs x86_64/amd64 images only and uses OnePay (not 9Pay) as the disbursement provider.
